cues.zh: 另一方面，關於凍結哪些層及其原因，還是有一些不錯的指引，

cues.en: those guidelines come from research on mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 而這些指引都來自機制可解釋性的研究。

cues.en: So I do think that the uncertainties with targeted freezing and fine tuning will improve over time, as there is more interpretability research being published.
cues.zh: 所以，隨著更多可解釋性研究發表，我認為針對性凍結與微調的這些不確定性，會逐漸改善。
